about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce paměťových čipů (DRAM, flash) a SSD disků.

about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Lam Research
about.summary: American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and related services to the semiconductor industry.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro výrobu čipů, hlavně pro leptání a nanášení vrstev.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce procesorů pro počítače a servery, který vyrábí čipy i na zakázku.

about.label: Snowflake Inc.
about.summary: American cloud-based artificial intelligence data platform company founded in San Mateo, California, and headquartered in Menlo Park.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudová platforma firmám ukládá a analyzuje data a pomáhá je využít pro umělou inteligenci.

about.label: Marvell Technology
about.summary: American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro datová centra, sítě a ukládání dat.

about.label: Western Digital
about.summary: American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, the company is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: Asia Vital Components (Taiwan)
about.summary: Taiwanese electronics company that produces computer cooling solutions.
about.summary_cs: Tchajwanská elektronická firma, která vyrábí chladicí systémy pro počítače a servery.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která chrání počítače a servery, sleduje hrozby a pomáhá řešit kybernetické útoky.

about.label: Arista Networks
about.summary: American provider of client to cloud networking services for large data center/AI, campus and routing environments.
about.summary_cs: Americký dodavatel síťových technologií pro velká datová centra, AI a firemní sítě.

about.label: Tower Semiconductor Ltd.
about.summary: Israeli company that manufactures integrated circuits using specialty process technologies, including SiGe, BiCMOS, Silicon Photonics, SOI, mixed-signal and RFCMOS, CMOS image sensors, non-imaging sensors, power management, and non-volatile memory as well as MEMS capabilities.
about.summary_cs: Izraelský výrobce čipů na zakázku, specializovaný na analogové a speciální technologie.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: SK Hynix
about.summary: South Korean semiconductor company that manufactures dynamic random-access memory chips and flash memory chips.
about.summary_cs: Jihokorejský výrobce paměťových čipů, hlavní dodavatel pamětí pro čipy umělé inteligence.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: M/A-COM Technology Solutions
about.summary: American developer and producer of radio, microwave, and millimeter wave semiconductor devices and components.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce polovodičů pro rádiové, mikrovlnné a milimetrové vlny, které se používají v telekomunikacích, datových centrech a obraně.

about.label: Flex Ltd.
about.summary: Singapore-domiciled multinational manufacturing company.
about.summary_cs: Nadnárodní firma, která na zakázku navrhuje a vyrábí elektroniku pro jiné značky.

about.label: Lattice Semiconductor
about.summary: American semiconductor company specializing in the design and manufacturing of low-power field-programmable gate arrays.
about.summary_cs: Americká polovodičová firma, která navrhuje programovatelné čipy (FPGA) s nízkou spotřebou.

about.label: Bloom Energy
about.summary: American public company that designs and manufactures solid oxide fuel cells which independently produce electricity onsite for power generation in data centers, manufacturing, and other commercial sectors.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí palivové články pro výrobu elektřiny přímo na místě – v datových centrech, továrnách a dalších provozech.

about.label: Onto Innovation
about.summary: American semiconductor company formed in 2019 from the merger of Rudolph Technologies, Inc. and Nanometrics Incorporated. It is a provider of process and process control equipment and software for microelectronic manufacturing industries.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení a software pro kontrolu a měření při výrobě čipů.

about.label: Okta
about.summary: American identity and access management company based in San Francisco. It provides cloud software that helps companies manage and secure user authentication into applications, and for developers to build identity controls into applications, websites, web services, and devices.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává cloudový software pro bezpečné přihlašování a správu uživatelských účtů.

about.label: Supermicro
about.summary: American information technology company based in San Jose, California. The company is one of the largest producers of high-performance and high-efficiency servers, while also providing server management software, and storage systems for various markets, including enterprise data centers, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, 5G, and edge computing.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce výkonných serverů, hlavně pro datová centra a umělou inteligenci.

about.label: Twilio
about.summary: American cloud communications company based in San Francisco, California, which provides programmable communication tools for making and receiving phone calls, sending and receiving text messages, and performing other communication functions using its web service APIs.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudové nástroje umožňují aplikacím posílat SMS, volat a komunikovat se zákazníky.

about.label: Tesla
about.summary: American multinational automotive and clean energy company. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles, stationary battery energy storage devices from home to grid-scale, solar panels and solar shingles, and related products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce elektromobilů, bateriových úložišť a solárních systémů.
